title: Reflex Budget
one_liner: Slide network latency and watch a cloud-controlled robot lose balance where an onboard brain stays upright.
headline: Drag a network-latency slider and watch a cloud-controlled stick-figure robot wobble and fall while its onboard-brain twin stays balanced.

episode.title: How Figure AI Is Outcompeting China and Tesla in Robotics | Robotic Deep-Dive w/ Brett Adcock

history.summary: A clean, dependency-free simulation that faithfully embodies Brett Adcock's 'reflex budget' point: the latency-to-Hz math matches the episode's verified figures, the preset button cites them correctly with a single short quote, and the UI is upfront that the balance physics is a toy. The one defect flagged in the prior review (an over-long strung-together transcript quote) has been fixed in v2, and the remaining gaps (no long-run empirical confirmation of the falls/min claim, a stray light/dark inconsistency) are minor enough to ship as improvements rather than blockers.
